events.title: Junior Book Club (Grades 2, 3, 4) Term Fee
events.description:
Junior Book Club Term FeeTuesdays during school term, 4:00-5:00pm
----------
Come along to our Junior Book Club & chat books! Every month, kids chat about books & participate in bookish activities, including craft, puzzles & games.
The dates for Term Three are:

Tues July 14th
Tues August 11th
Tues September 15th

This book club is suitable for independent readers in grades 2, 3, 4 with a reading age of 7-9. 

The reading theme for term three is Landscapes: Land, Sky & Sea. The books are available to collect in-store now! You can view the list of books here. 

Term fee is $30/term. It is a requirement to purchase the book club books from us. All JR book club members receive 15% off all reads in their age group.

Please get in touch if your child is interested in attending!

events.title: Spring Book Swap
events.description:
Spring Book Swap Saturday 19th September, 10am-1pm
**Please register for the book swap so we can gauge how much space we need on the day. *Select quantity for number of people attending*Select click & collect > reserve now to reserve a ticket. 
Time to spring clean your bookshelves and pop down to The Mad Hatters Bookshop for some new reads! Pop in between 10am-1pm on Saturday 19 September and bring a book to trade!
This Book Swap is a ONE-FOR-ONE trade with a limit of three books per person. 
RULES
*No textbooks, reference materials, manuals or magazines*Max three books per person*Books in good condition accepted (no yellowed pages, speckling, stains or major tears) We reserve the right to reject books that are not clean or readable*No mass dumping of books
